part: Livox Mid-360 scanning lidar, mounted upside down under the drone
_max_range_m: Datasheet: 40 m at 10% reflectivity, 70 m at 80%. Terrain and vegetation are dark targets, so 40 m.
_noise: ASSUMPTION from the datasheet class: about 2 cm range precision (1 sigma).
_pattern: 360 deg horizontal, elevation -7..+52 deg upright, i.e. -52..+7 inverted; sampled as 80 beams per 10 Hz frame of the ~200k pts/s.
_price: ASSUMPTION: Livox store list price. Retailer quotes seen 2026-10 range from about GBP 530 (Alibaba sample) to EUR 773 incl. VAT (mybotshop.de).
